business_problem: Xoople needed to turn massive volumes of satellite and geospatial data into enterprise-ready AI assets that customers in industries such as agriculture, logistics and insurance could actually consume inside their workflows, while also addressing market fit, privacy and trust.
solution_summary: Xoople and EY expanded Earth observation data into a commercial AI platform by working across market design, data engineering and trust. EY first helped validate target industries and create go-to-market playbooks explaining how Earth data intelligence could be integrated into enterprise use cases. On the technical side, the joint team transformed complex geospatial inputs into AI-ready data sets using multimodal AI and Generative AI techniques, while working with hyperscaler collaborators including Microsoft and Databricks to make those data sets consumable across different enterprise architectures. Open, platform-agnostic data formats were created so customers could adapt the outputs within their own stacks, and the program added zero-trust security, least-privilege access controls and continuous verification to make the data trustworthy. The result was an Earth-data intelligence foundation that can deliver predictive business insights rather than raw satellite imagery.
